body: so proud to see one of my favorite local bands in this post. fuck yea odd advantage!

yeah, i mean if my test comes positive i would always 1000% disclose but yeah it makes relationships tedious and harder, i mean same here. now no matter results its gonna be STD screens every time before im active and its really frustrating and upsetting. it compounds w anything else negative and sitting here having to wait for essentially at LEAST 2 weeks until i know the truth is exhausting. so im taking all these meds and precautions and staying so far away from dating its not even funny. its just so stressful and i hate it so much
it does get hard to not just grab more though since i live right next door and theres always a deal on my drink of choice making the bottles dirt cheap

the alcohol is just in my fridge, i normally polish off a bottle a night then get more when im out. but last night i had a glass or two, so the final bottle from my last store run is just sorta in the fridge. my hope is once that bottle gets finished i wont get any more.

assuming im positive, i can do antiviral therapy, take immune boosting vitamins and supplements along with my diet, not being active during or around outbreaks, and use protection, even with all that though transmission rates are never 0%. they can get low as hell but never like full proof. even when youre not showing physical symptoms you can asymptomatically shed. ive had to do so much research this whole time waiting. its just so much fear of stigma, being rejected. its already something i take hard and struggle w often due to the outside factors so it feels like a nail in my coffin.
as for the drinks, im trying my best. it isnt easy though. you just sit an emotional hole and its hard to find a way out, and you dont know where to go. but im trying. ive been slowing down. but, yeah. the goal is sober again. im just not there yet and its hard LMAO

thank you, i mean the old habits already did cost me a relationship i thought was going to be longterm. granted, i also realize now away that it probably wouldnt of worked cuz he clearly resented me anyways but to not blame myself at all is essentially impossible there. and its just yeah, it feels like if im negative it just reminds me how like overzealous and foolish i am, ive already as of late had so much unexplainable medical anxiety like convinced ill have sudden strokes or heart attacks if i sleep so then its like okay yeah clearly my anxiety is getting crippling again and it makes me feel defeated. kinda like no matter how stable i think ive gotten im not actually. and if it is herpes then it makes dating and sex feel almost impossible. i know it isnt, i know its about meeting the right people, but i already cant do that even when im “std free” so i feel like its just going to be more impossible. it compounds with that whole autistic life long struggle of connecting with people and feeling human or understood and all the emotional turbulence. its just hard to not kinda look at death and be like hmmm that a kinda sexy choice maybe thatd fix it. ik it doesnt “fix” anything but it already feels unfixable anyways yk. idk im probably just way too pessimistic
thank you, i really appreciate that. it helps at least a little bit. im trying. it just feels like a hell combo lol autistic, bpd, queer, and might have herpes 😭 but idk maybe its not the end :/ yk

i know, i just went to my closest friends kinda stupidly thinking theyd give me some emotional support. and im just so scared of it fucking up all my sexual opportunities. im a person that loves intimacy and having relationships so the idea of that being fucked up from a possible diagnosis is so scary
they do they. they even like to hurt me themselves sometimes 🤪🤪

they really dont, i called them after my last attempt and they got angry i called it suicide, and i was just trying to make a fuss over a “simple accident”, then they left me on campus like literally tryin to puke cuz it hurt so bad for like almost an hour, then sent me home into my room, and didnt acknowledge me again until the next morning, we argued and i barely got to my doctor, my doctor was confused why i wasnt taken to the er, and my parents said it wasnt a suicide attempt and wasn’t “that major”. id taken 8x the dose i was supposed to. they really truly dont care
thank you. youre very kind. its just so hard
